___________
No. 2 of 2025
AN ACT to amend the Security Interest in Movable Property
Act, No. 22 of 2022.
[ 17th March, 2025 ]
BE IT ENACTED by the King’s Most Excellent Majesty, by
and with the advice and consent of the House of Assembly and the
Senate of Saint Lucia, and by the authority of the same, as follows:

8
No. 2 ] Security Interest in Movable Property [ 2025
(Amendment) Act
Short title
1. This Act may be cited as the Security Interest in Movable
Property (Amendment) Act, 2025.
Amendment of section 3
2. Section 3(1) of the Security Interest in Movable Property
Act, No. 22 of 2022 is amended, in paragraph (a), by inserting
immediately after the word “transaction” the words “that does not
involve immovable property”.
Passed in the House of Assembly this 25th day of February, 2025.
CLAUDIUS J. FRANCIS,
Speaker of the House of Assembly.
Passed in the Senate this 27th day of February, 2025.
ALVINA REYNOLDS,
President of the Senate.
